title: M PLUS 1p
description: A neutral proportional Japanese gothic in the M+ OUTLINE FONTS line. It has no strong mannerism and works widely for subtitles, UI, and body captions. It is the non-rounded pair of the bundled M PLUS Rounded 1c. OFL-1.1 allows a later promotion into the bundled binaries (today this is an index only).
when_to_use: For pop or information captions that want a plain gothic, not a rounded gothic
ai_usage: OFL-1.1 のため実体同梱への昇格が可能（昇格はオーナー裁定）。現状は索引のみ。グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
